evidence_quote: Two new mutations in the LAMP2 gene were identified in two index cases (fig 2).
note: Two index patients described individually; the mildly affected carrier mother and four deceased relatives in family B are not counted.

evidence_quote: LAMP2 gene mutations were identified in all three male patients who showed LAMP-2 protein deficiency and in the heterozygote female patient 4.
Genetic analysis revealed a thymine deletion at position 121 (121 delT) in exon 2 of the LAMP2 gene, thereby confirming the diagnosis of Danon disease.
The third decedent with a pathogenic variant had a large ∼136 kb deletion of band q24 of chromosome X which contained part of LAMP2 gene known to be causative of X-linked dominant Danon disease
note: Close call: one decedent with a de novo LAMP2 deletion called pathogenic (LVH, intellectual disability, arrhythmias) but no typical Danon histopathology at autopsy.

evidence_quote: The NM\_002294.2: c.444\_445insT (p.Asp149*) pathogenic variant was identified in the LAMP2 gene, the only gene known to cause Danon disease.
